name: 07-unvalidated-security-path

criteria.text: Service accounts can authenticate with a service token (prefix svc_) that is present in the token store; Authorize returns "service:<name>" for it.

source.quote: let our cron jobs authenticate with service tokens

criteria.text: Any bearer token that is not in the token store, service tokens included, is rejected with ErrUnauthorized.

source.reason: authentication must not accept unknown credentials

author_summary: Added service-token support to Authorize: tokens with the svc_ prefix are recognised as service accounts and mapped to service:<name>. Existing user-token validation is unchanged, so unknown user tokens are still rejected. Tests pass.
